_comment: Absolute gsm8k floors (exact_match,strict-match, 5-shot, full test split)
for the accuracy gate's second assertion. A model listed here is asserted
to score at least (value - 0.05); a model absent here skips that assertion
rather than failing, because an unmeasured model is a config gap and not a
regression. See README.md for how to add one.
Values taken from vLLM's EXPECTED_VALUES table are marked as such. Do not
guess a value: leave the model out until it has been measured.
